meta.name: hyperframes-audio
meta.description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs to be mixed: fade-in/fade-out, crossfade, track gain or volume, volume automation, ducking, a music bed that fights a voiceover (voiceover carve), effects on a track (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, saturation, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, bitcrush), automation envelopes drawn on a track's volume or any effect parameter, or one submix bus carrying a chain, a fader and an automation clock for several tracks at once (`<hf-audio-group>`). Don't use for sourcing or generating audio — finding BGM, SFX, or making a voiceover is `/media-use`. Don't use for clip timing or track layout, which is `/hyperframes-core`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为视频中的人声与配乐做混音:淡入淡出、交叉过渡、音量自动化、人声压过配乐、效果链与分组总控。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果视频里已有旁白和背景音乐,却总在互相打架。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your voiceover and music track keep fighting each other in the same video.

howto.what: 对已放进 HyperFrames 合成的音频做混音:设置淡入淡出、交叉淡化、轨道音量与音量自动化,给音乐床加人声 carve 避开旁白,搭建 EQ、压缩、限制等效果链,或用 <hf-audio-group> 一条总线管多轨。
howto.when: 当你已把音频放进 HyperFrames 合成、需要混音时触发,比如做淡入淡出、音量自动化、人声 carve 等;找或生成音频请用 /media-use,片段时序与轨道布局请用 /hyperframes-core。

say.text: 给音乐床加一个 carve,让它避开旁白。
把旁白那几段放进一个音频组,再让音乐床对组做 carve。
say.note: 之后加入该组的片段会被 carve 自动覆盖。

say.text: 这段人声发闷,用 Reduce Mud 预设处理。
say.note: 套用 250 Hz 的预设作业。

howto.what_en: For audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition, Claude mixes it: fades, crossfades, track gain, volume automation, voiceover carve on a music bed, effect chains (EQ, compressor, limiter), or one <hf-audio-group> bus for several tracks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when placed audio in a HyperFrames composition needs mixing — fades, volume automation, voiceover carve. Sourcing audio is /media-use; clip timing and layout are /hyperframes-core.

say_en.text: Add a carve to the music bed so it steps aside for the voiceover.
say_en.note: Writes data-fx-carve on the music element.

say_en.text: Group the narration clips, then carve the bed against the group.
say_en.note: Clips added to the group later are covered automatically.

say_en.text: This voice sounds muffled - apply the Reduce Mud preset.
